the presidency stated that Egypt sought consensus on civilian protection, international humanitarian law, humanitarian access, and preventing regional spillover.","notes":["The excerpt attributes the invitation to the Arab Republic of Egypt, not explicitly to el-Sisi personally."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E011","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":"At el-Sisi’s invitation, Egypt convened the Sudan’s Neighboring States Summit in Cairo on 13 July 2023; the excerpt does not establish disbursement."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E018","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"El-Sisi directed public, public-business, and private-sector establishments to employ persons with disabilities at 5% of their workforce, called for the Ministry of Manpower to launch a national labor-market information platform, and called for procedures to increase women’s employment, provide safe workplaces, and integrate women into the labor market.","notes":["The excerpt supports launching the platform, not merely preparing it."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E019","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E020","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"World Bank WITS reported Egypt’s 2023 exports at US$42.553 billion and imports at US$84.218 billion, with 2,990 exported products and 4,048 imported products traded with 182 export partners.","notes":["The supplied excerpt does not show the number of import partners, so 184 is unsupported."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E021","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In 2023, Egypt’s exports were concentrated mainly in consumer goods (39.87%) and intermediate goods (37.96%), while imports included intermediate goods (30.85%), consumer goods (30.04%), and capital goods (18.28%); country trade growth was reported at -9.03%.","notes":["The supplied excerpt does not report a trade balance of -US$8.862 billion."]}]}
